subject: Vendor enablement launchpad & PO ramp — kickoff scheduling and MAP alignment
messages:
From: Julia Park <julia.park@acmecorp.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff for vendor onboarding & PO process

Hi Irene —

Thanks for the intro last week. We (Procurement Ops — Julia & Tom) are ready to kick off vendor enablement with Redwood so we can get POs flowing for our sandbox and pilot projects. High-level asks:

- Walkthrough of Redwood vendor onboarding checklist and billing contacts
- Confirm preferred PO template and invoicing cadence
- Agree on MAP (mutual action plan) with milestones for provisioning, security evidence, and first invoice

Would you have 30–45 minutes this week for a kickoff? Timezone: PT.

Also, can you share any onboarding checklist and the PO template ahead of the call so our finance team can pre-review?

Thanks,
Julia Park
Senior Procurement Manager | Acme Corp
procurement@acmecorp.com

Hi Julia —

Thanks — glad to get this moving. I can do a 30–45m slot tomorrow (May 11) between 10:00–13:00 PT, or Thursday morning if that works better. Proposed agenda below; I attached our standard vendor enablement checklist and the PO template for Acme to review before the call.

Proposed kickoff agenda (30–45m):
1) Introductions & stakeholders (5m)
2) Vendor enablement checklist walkthrough (10m)
3) PO template, invoicing cadence, and billing contacts (10m)
4) MAP draft review: milestones, owners, target dates (10m)
5) Next steps & action items (5m)

Success criteria we typically aim for on the MAP: vendor account provisioned, SOC2 evidence uploaded (if required), PO issued, and first invoice scheduled within agreed cycle.

Attachments: RI-vendor-enablement-checklist.xlsx; Acme-PO-template.pdf; Mutual-Action-Plan-draft.docx

If those times don't work, send a couple of alternatives and we'll adjust.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

Team — forwarding Acme's request and the items I attached. Quick internal notes before the call:

- Vanessa: please cover the enablement checklist walkthrough and provisioning timeline (owner: Vanessa)
- Karthik: you cover the billing/PO template and billing contact handoff to finance (owner: Karthik)
- Marissa: can you own the MAP doc and capture deadlines during the call, then publish to the shared Drive?

Target MAP milestones to propose:
A) Account provisioning & basic access (3 business days)
B) Security evidence intake (5–7 business days after provisioning)
C) PO issued (within 7 business days of contract signature)
D) First invoice scheduled (next billing cycle after PO)

I'll confirm the meeting time once Julia replies with availability. Please review the attached checklist and PO template before EOD so we can answer Acme's questions live.

Thanks —
Irene
